findings.finding: Initial homepage HTML contained no H1 or public body copy before implementation.
findings.evidence: .seo/baseline/home-before.json: h1=[], links.internal=[], schema=[]; initial root was empty.
findings.fix: Build-time prerender the identical public React trees for visitors and crawlers.

findings.finding: robots sitemap and AI-readable summaries returned 404 before implementation.
findings.fix: Serve discovery files for seven canonical public pages.

findings.finding: Initial homepage had no canonical social metadata or JSON-LD.
findings.fix: Unique page titles/descriptions, canonical links, OG/Twitter and factual schemas.

findings.finding: Unknown extensionless HTML navigations previously returned homepage 200.
findings.evidence: Previous server/http.mjs used unrestricted HTML SPA fallback; original production-http test explicitly expected /about 200.
findings.fix: Allowlist seven public routes with canonical redirects and real noindex 404 responses.

findings.finding: PageSpeed field and lab scores are unavailable in this audit.
findings.evidence: .seo/baseline/pagespeed-before.json contains Google API rate-limit error and null performance score.
findings.fix: Measure with PageSpeed/CrUX after quota is available; do not infer actual CWV from build size.

findings.finding: Index coverage rankings and AI citations are unverified.
findings.evidence: No Search Console/Baidu/Bing verified account reports or AI referral analytics supplied.
findings.fix: Verify webmaster properties, submit sitemap, inspect URLs and observe real results.
